title: Do you eat dinner late?
grammar: Present simple: questions and adverbs of frequency
vocab_topic: Daily routines, meals and times of day
pair_game: Point at a picture. Ask: “Do you … ?” Your partner answers with always, usually, sometimes or never. Then swap!

grammar_box.title: Do you …? How often?
rows: Yes, I do. / No, I do not.
grammar_box.tip: always, usually, sometimes, never go BEFORE the verb: I never eat late.

questions: What time do you usually eat breakfast?
Do you eat fruit every day?
What do you usually eat for lunch at school?
Do you drink milk in the morning?
How often do you eat fast food?
Do you help your mom or dad cook?
When do you usually go to bed?
Do you eat snacks after school?
starters: Yes, I do. We eat at … . / No, we eat early, at … .
Yes, I eat … every day. / No, I sometimes … .
For lunch at school I usually eat … .
Yes, I do. / No, I never drink milk. I drink … .
I eat fast food … (never / sometimes / once a week).
Yes, I help my … . I usually … . / No, I do not.
I usually go to bed at … .
Yes, I do. I eat … after school. / No, I wait for dinner.
samples: Yes, we **usually** do. We eat at nine o'clock because my father works until eight.
How often do you eat fast food?
I eat fast food **sometimes**, maybe once a month. My mother says it is not healthy.
When do you usually go to bed?
I **always** go to bed at ten o'clock. On Saturdays I go to bed later, at eleven.

survey.title: Class survey
survey.question: What time do you eat dinner?

game.title: Guess my day!
game.rules: Take a card. Do not show it! Read the two sentences. Your group guesses who it is.
items: I get up at five o'clock. I never eat breakfast at home.
I always eat dinner at six. I go to bed at nine.
I usually have soup for lunch. I never drink coffee.
I sometimes get up late. I always eat a big breakfast.
I never eat late. I always brush my teeth after dinner.
I usually do my homework before dinner. I never watch TV in the morning.

mini_talk.title: My normal day
plan: Say when you go to bed
mini_talk.model: I **always** get up at half past six. I **usually** have bread and tea for breakfast at seven. At school I eat lunch at one o'clock, **usually** soup. My family eats dinner **late**, at nine, because we wait for my father. After dinner I read a little and I **never** go to bed before ten o'clock.

cando: ask and answer Do you …? questions
use always, usually, sometimes and never
